Synopsis:
    Viet Dinh, former Fox Corp Chief Legal & Policy Officer, is joining Sullivan & Cromwell as a partner in its LA office. Dinh departed Fox after its $787.5M Dominion settlement and received a $23M separation payment. He brings credentials as a former U.S. AG under Bush and Patriot Act architect. The article also notes S&C's ongoing representation of Trump in both his criminal conviction appeal and NY civil fraud case.
